content:
Let the erased number be \(x\). Then

\[
\frac{\frac{N(N+1)}2-x}{N-1}=\frac{45}{4}
\]

so

\[
4\left(\frac{N(N+1)}2-x\right)=45(N-1)
\]

\[
2N(N+1)-4x=45N-45
\]

\[
x=\frac{2N^2-43N+45}{4}
\]

We need integer \(N\) with \(1\le x\le N\). Divisibility by \(4\) gives \(N\equiv 1\pmod 4\). Also \(x\le N\) gives

\[
\frac{2N^2-43N+45}{4}\le N
\]

\[
2N^2-47N+45\le 0
\]

whose valid integer solution is \(N=21\). Then

\[
x=\frac{2(21)^2-43(21)+45}{4}
=\frac{882-903+45}{4}
=6
\]

Thus the erased number was \(\boxed{6}\).
